grf.observed_reality: PR 754 added an exact Git HEAD and clean-worktree check before freezing EntityOS, but its git subprocess inherited the caller environment.
grf.generated_reality: The new provenance gate would bind the one-file build receipt to the actual checked-out clean product source revision.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: Ambient Git environment variables can redirect repository/worktree interpretation so the verifier measures different bytes than PyInstaller freezes.
grf.discriminator: Redirect GIT_WORK_TREE to a clean alternate worktree while mutating the actual build root, then call the candidate provenance verifier against the exact expected HEAD.

unusual_experiment.intervention: Mutate the real tracked build source and set inherited GIT_WORK_TREE to a separate clean worktree before invoking the candidate verifier.
unusual_experiment.security_effect: The candidate verifier accepted the expected HEAD while the actual source root used by the build contained modified tracked bytes.
unusual_experiment.rollback: Ephemeral repositories and alternate worktree were temporary; no canonical source mutation came from the experiment itself.

product_delta.fix: Remove inherited GIT_* variables from the environment of provenance git subprocesses before resolving HEAD and worktree cleanliness.
product_delta.regression: Add a GIT_WORK_TREE redirect case that must reject the dirty real build source.

coordination.constraint: Do not force-overwrite either lane; fuse current main with the executor improvements and retest an exact descendant in Vercel Sandbox.

next_executable_step: Create a fresh non-stale fusion descendant of current product main that preserves the merged EntityOS provenance fence and the five Vercel executor-lane improvements, then run the authorized Vercel Sandbox matrix on that exact SHA and persist the resulting EntityOS SHA256, reproducibility, runtime, relocation and recovery receipts. Do not use VPS, self-hosted runners, or production hosts as test evidence.
